status_note: Stage 2a (S0b) word patterns for text typed in the chat (PRD-FR-03, PRD 4.7.1, GOLD IG-01). Each rule restates one existing draft trigger in emergency.draft-0.1.json and adds no new trigger. A rule fires when the text contains at least one word from every group. Matching ignores negation on purpose, so 'no sudden severe testicle pain' also fires: a false alarm shows emergency guidance, and a missed alarm is the worse error. English only; text in another script is not sent anywhere and the user is asked to use the buttons. No clinician has approved these patterns (OD-02, OQ-30). The browser does not use this file.
